description: Expander for øchd, taking its eight LFOs and deriving sixteen more outputs from them; it goes immediately beside øchd, on either side of it

outputs.text: A full wave rectified copy of øchd's LFO 1, unipolar positive at 0-5V and at twice that LFO's frequency
A full wave rectified copy of øchd's LFO 3, unipolar positive at 0-5V and at twice that LFO's frequency
A full wave rectified copy of øchd's LFO 7, unipolar positive at 0-5V and at twice that LFO's frequency
A full wave rectified copy of øchd's LFO 5, unipolar positive at 0-5V and at twice that LFO's frequency
Whichever of øchd's LFO 2 and LFO 3 is the higher voltage at each moment, -5V to 5V
Whichever of øchd's LFO 6 and LFO 7 is the higher voltage at each moment, -5V to 5V
Whichever of øchd's LFO 6 and LFO 7 is the lower voltage at each moment, -5V to 5V
Whichever of øchd's LFO 2 and LFO 3 is the lower voltage at each moment, -5V to 5V
An 8ms trigger at the start of the rising edge of øchd's LFO 2
An 8ms trigger at the start of the rising edge of øchd's LFO 4
An 8ms trigger at the start of the rising edge of øchd's LFO 8
An 8ms trigger at the start of the rising edge of øchd's LFO 6
A stepped random voltage from a four bit ladder fed by øchd's LFOs 1, 2, 3 and 4, with LFO 1 as the most significant bit
A stepped random voltage from a four bit ladder fed by øchd's LFOs 5, 6, 7 and 8, with LFO 5 as the most significant bit
A stepped random voltage from a four bit ladder fed by øchd's even numbered LFOs, with LFO 2 as the most significant bit
A stepped random voltage from a four bit ladder fed by øchd's odd numbered LFOs, with LFO 1 as the most significant bit

notes: It has no oscillator of its own, and nothing reaches its outputs unless an øchd is standing against it
øchd can be on either side of it; with one on each side it follows the øchd on its left
